title: Arabic request naming a specific block
request: أضف قسم أسئلة شائعة فيه أربعة أسئلة عن الشحن والدفع.
rubric: Are there four Arabic questions about shipping and payment, with Arabic answers?
why: Block selection must work from Arabic words, not only from English keywords. This is the case that fails first when catalog matching is English-only.
